# Check who uses an API first

Coding rule · `S2.4`

Before changing any V2 endpoint, list its consumers: mobile (App/config/index.js constant + call sites), app/UserMcp / app/FindMcp ('uri' =>), web (if shared).

Part of [[Hubs/Coding rules|Coding rules]].
